title: SKILL.md walker correctness: worktree path, conflict-marker guard, walk-state-write drain (bugs #1, #6, #7) + CHANGELOG + version bump
definition_of_done: reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md step 5b uses WT="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/cloverleaf/walker/<PLAN-ID>-<TASK-ID>" and adds mkdir -p "$(dirname "$WT")" before git worktree add; no /tmp/walker-* path remains anywhere in SKILL.md

SKILL.md drain merge sequence (section 5e or equivalent) contains a grep step that scans all changed files for conflict markers (<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) and aborts before git merge --no-ff if any are found
SKILL.md drain sequence emits a cloverleaf-cli walk-state-write call immediately after a successful git merge --no-ff, recording state: "merged" and the merge_commit SHA

reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md contains a ## 0.6.1 section listing all seven bug fixes and a migration note that consumers upgrading from v0.6.0 should run cloverleaf-run-plan <PLAN-ID> --reset before the first v0.6.1 invocation on any plan with a stale walk-state.json; no cloverleaf-cli walk-state-reconcile subcommand is introduced
reference-impl/package.json version field is updated to 0.6.1
All changes pass the existing reference-impl test suite (npm test in reference-impl/)
acceptance_criteria: The walker skill template in reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md uses the XDG_CACHE_HOME-based path and no longer references /tmp/walker-* paths anywhere (RFC AC #7)
A grep -r '/tmp/walker' reference-impl/skills/ returns no matches after the patch
The SKILL.md drain step contains a conflict-marker grep that aborts merge when <<<<<<, =======, or >>>>>>> appear in any changed file (RFC AC #10, reproduces bug #6)
The SKILL.md drain step contains a cloverleaf-cli walk-state-write call after each successful git merge --no-ff that records state: merged and the merge_commit SHA (RFC AC #10, reproduces bug #7)
reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md has a ## 0.6.1 section covering all seven bug fixes and the --reset migration note (RFC AC #6)
No cloverleaf-cli walk-state-reconcile subcommand or equivalent one-shot reconciler command is introduced (RFC AC #11)
@cloverleaf/standard package.json is not modified; standard version remains 0.4.1 (RFC AC #5)
